Acropolis Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Accenture Plc Ireland for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $97.94B market cap company. The stock increased 1.47% or $2.2 $152.29. About 1.63M shares traded. Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) has risen 24.68% uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.13% the S&P500.
